"""Retain the frozen six-host comparison after completion; never run measurements."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

task = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = task.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / 'bench'))
import qualify_scc as scc

base = task / 'pivot-linux-collected'
main = base / 'main'
jobs = [8233028, 8233030, 8233031, 8233032, 8233033, 8233034]

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def encode(obj, indent=0):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        items = []
        for key, value in obj.items():
            if key in ('calls', 'warmups') and isinstance(value, list):
                body = '[\n' + ',\n'.join(' ' * (indent+2) + json.dumps(row, separators=(',', ':')) for row in value) + '\n' + ' ' * (indent+1) + ']'
            else:
                body = encode(value, indent+1)
            items.append(' ' * (indent+1) + json.dumps(key) + ': ' + body)
        return '{\n' + ',\n'.join(items) + '\n' + ' ' * indent + '}'
    if isinstance(obj, list):
        if any(isinstance(row, dict) for row in obj):
            return '[\n' + ',\n'.join(' ' * (indent+1) + encode(row, indent+1) for row in obj) + '\n' + ' ' * indent + ']'
        return json.dumps(obj, separators=(',', ':'))
    return json.dumps(obj)

def host_record(result, folder):
    host = result['host']
    assert host['isolation_ok'] and not host['errors']
    path = folder / 'host-0' / host['observations']
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert not any(row['kind'] == 'error' for row in events)
    processes = [row for row in events if row['kind'] == 'process']
    assert processes and not any(row['competing_compute'] for row in processes)
    gap = max((b['monotonic_ns']-a['monotonic_ns'])/1e9 for a,b in zip(processes,processes[1:]))
    assert gap <= 7.5
    scheduler = []
    for row in events:
        if row['kind'] == 'process':
            continue
        raw = row['raw']
        item = {k:v for k,v in row.items() if k != 'raw'}
        item['raw_sha256'] = {k:hashlib.sha256(v.encode()).hexdigest() for k,v in raw.items()}
        if row['kind'] == 'reservation':
            item['validated_queue'] = scc.validate_reservation(raw,host['host'],8)
        else:
            assert row['kind'] == 'census'
            scc.validate_census(raw['job'],raw['queues'],host['host'])
            item['job_resources'] = scc.fields(raw['job'],colon=True)['hard resource_list']
            item['queue_jobs'] = [{'name':q.findtext('name'),'jobs':[{'id':j.findtext('JB_job_number'),'slots':j.findtext('slots')} for j in q.findall('job_list')]} for q in ET.fromstring(raw['queues']).findall('./queue_info/Queue-List')]
        scheduler.append(item)
    return {'raw_sha256':sha(path),'process_samples':len(processes),'maximum_gap_seconds':gap,
            'maximum_duration_seconds':max((r['finished_monotonic_ns']-r['monotonic_ns'])/1e9 for r in processes),
            'competing_compute_observations':0,'errors':[],
            'scheduler_observations':scheduler,
            'limits':'Sampled coverage, not continuous or call-specific proof. Ordinary activity retained.'}

summary_path = main / 'summary.json'
summary = read(summary_path)
assert summary['status'] == 'diagnostic_complete' and summary['native_calls'] == 1080
assert not summary['errors'] and len(summary['comparisons']) == 24
records = []
for replica, job in enumerate(jobs):
    folder = main / f'run-{replica}-0'
    result_path = folder / 'results.json'
    result = read(result_path)
    assert result['status'] == 'complete' and not result['failures']
    assert result['replica'] == replica and result['shard'] == 0
    assert result['budget_compliant'] and result['elapsed_s'] < 3600
    assert len(result['cases']) == 12
    assert sum(len(c['warmups'])+sum(len(b['calls']) for b in c['blocks']) for c in result['cases']) == 180
    accounting_path = base / 'accounting' / f'{job}.1.txt'
    fields = scc.fields(accounting_path.read_text())
    assert fields['jobnumber'] == str(job) and fields['failed'].split()[0] == fields['exit_status'] == '0'
    assert fields['hostname'].split('.')[0] == result['hostname'].split('.')[0]
    accounting = {'sha256':sha(accounting_path), **{k:fields[k] for k in ('jobnumber','taskid','qname','hostname','project','granted_pe','slots','start_time','end_time','failed','exit_status','ru_wallclock','cpu','maxvmem')}}
    records.append({'replica':replica,'source_result_sha256':sha(result_path),'accounting':accounting,
                    'observer':host_record(result,folder),'result':result})
assert len({r['result']['hostname'].split('.')[0] for r in records}) == 6

source = Path(__file__).read_text()
prior_path = repo / 'bench/results/cmg-setup-pivot-linux-part1-20261021.json'
prior = read(prior_path) if prior_path.exists() else {}
if prior.get('replicas'):
    assert prior['replicas'][0]['result'] == records[0]['result']
    assert prior['replicas'][0]['source_result_sha256'] == records[0]['source_result_sha256']
operations = {key:prior[key] for key in ('operations','operational_notes','read_only_scheduler_diagnostics') if key in prior}
resolution = 'The five delayed jobs subsequently dispatched on their unchanged final hosts at 17:28-17:29 and completed during 17:31-17:32 on 2026-10-21. Same job IDs, artifacts and budgets; no resubmission. The exact cause of the earlier scheduler delay remains unproven.'
operations['operational_notes'] = [note for note in operations.get('operational_notes', []) if not note.startswith('The five delayed jobs subsequently dispatched')]
if resolution not in operations.setdefault('operational_notes', []):
    operations['operational_notes'].append(resolution)
patch_failure = 'A final documentation/retention metadata patch failed its context match before changing files. The corrected patch changed metadata only; no native execution, observation or report was affected. Tool-trace-only event; no separate log hash.'
if patch_failure not in operations['operational_notes']:
    operations['operational_notes'].append(patch_failure)
reviews = {
    'statistics': {
        'method': 'Independent recomputation without qualify.score/interval; seconds field, geometric mean paired occurrences, allowance max(5%,1ms), median of two block excesses within each of six physical hosts, binomial one-sided alpha .025.',
        'verified': 'All 288 paired block scores and 24 bounds agree within floating-point rounding; maximum discrepancy 7.8e-16. All 216 retained warmup logs match NATIVE_SECONDS. 1080 calls = 216 warmups + 864 scored calls, with no retries or additional attempts.',
        'inconclusive': 'high-degree-weak-t1 vs accepted_3f9_hidden; wo4 contributes upper host excess +28.535722371ms, from blocks +60.438579ms and -3.367134ms. Those observations establish neither a cause nor an exclusion basis.',
        'limits': 'At n=6 the selected upper bound is the maximum host excess. Raw scored logs were not retained; timer provenance follows the frozen hash-matching reader. Mac remains independently inconclusive. No pooling, exclusion, extra sampling or activation follows.'
    },
    'execution_science_retention': {
        'verified': 'All 1080 call objects and six full result objects/source hashes match originals exactly. Fixed schedules, no retries or failed calls; exact cross-arm science and repeats. All 216 retained heads/array sets rehashed; cross-worker/cross-host scientific agreement and stable discrete/hierarchy decisions. All 216 warmup timers match NATIVE_SECONDS. Six distinct 28-slot/CPU-affinity hosts, reservation/census checks and accounting 0/0. All observer/accounting summaries match sources: 232 process samples, maximum gap 6.710s, maximum duration .155s, no recorded competing compute.',
        'limits': 'Timed raw logs were deleted by the maintained runner. The two reference binaries and Linux timing wrapper were unavailable for independent local rehash; the candidate binary, available inputs/references and execution sources verified. Independent numerical oracle execution was not repeated. Sampled host coverage is not continuous proof. Mac and Linux each retain one inconclusive bound; no exclusions, extra sampling, policy advancement or activation follows.'
    }
}
check = read(task / 'setup1-review/checks/pivot-root-linux-report.json')
assert check['exit'] == 0 and check['before'] == check['after']
report_check = {key:check[key] for key in ('label','exit','elapsed_s','log_sha256')}
report_check['head'] = check['before']['head'].strip()
report_check['command'] = ['<private-python>', 'bench/cmg_setup.py', 'report', '<task>/plan-pivot-Linux.json', '--output', '<task>/pivot-linux-collected/main', '--accounting', '<task>/pivot-linux-collected/accounting']
for part, group in enumerate((records[:3],records[3:]),1):
    document = {'schema':1,'date':'2026-10-21','part':part,'parts':2,
                'purpose':'Frozen pivot setup comparison on six distinct Linux hosts; no activation qualification.',
                'protocol_file':'bench/results/cmg-setup-pivot-20261021.json',
                'protocol_sha256':sha(repo / 'bench/results/cmg-setup-pivot-20261021.json'),
                'plan_sha256':sha(task / 'plan-pivot-Linux.json'),
                'source_summary_sha256':sha(summary_path),'summary':summary,
                'report_check':report_check,
                'independent_reviews':reviews,
                'assessment':{state:sum(row['status'] == state for row in summary['comparisons']) for state in ('passed','inconclusive','regression')},
                'timing':'The scored seconds field is complete-call NATIVE_SECONDS. The inherited timing_field label says native_s; the separate auxiliary native_s field is not scored.',
                **(operations if part == 1 else {}),
                'retention':'All 1080 complete call objects retained across the two parts. Raw logs and numerical arrays are not committed. Numerical references checked by the maintained report. Ordinary noise and every completed call retained.',
                'limits':['Six physical hosts are analysis units, not a proof of independence.','Per-cell bounds are not a simultaneous guarantee for all 24 comparisons.','The separate Mac comparison remains inconclusive; no extra samples, policy advancement or activation.'],
                'retention_tool':{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),'source':source},
                'replicas':group}
    text = encode(document)+'\n'
    assert chr(47)+'Users'+chr(47) not in text and chr(47)+'usr2'+chr(47) not in text
    assert len(text.encode()) < 1_000_000
    path=repo / f'bench/results/cmg-setup-pivot-linux-part{part}-20261021.json'
    path.write_text(text)
    print(path.name,len(text.encode()),sha(path))
